meaning:
ἀνα-ζάω, -ῶ
[in Al.: Gen.45:27 * ;]
to live again, regain life (cf. cl. ἀναβιόω; Cremer, 722; and for other exx., v MM, VGT, see word): metaphorically of moral revival, Luk.15:24 (WH, mg., ἔζησεν); of sin, Rom.7:9.†
(AS)
glosses: sprang to life and i died

renderings.bsb: sprang to life and I died

elsewhere.note: for this, my son, was dead, and is alive again. He was lost, and is found.’ Then they began to celebrate.
I was alive apart from the law once, but when the commandment came, sin revived, and I died.
